name: Media History
location: Chrome: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data\<Profile>\Media History ; Edge: %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\<Profile>\Media History (Chromium browsers only; no Firefox equivalent)
purpose: SQLite database tracking audio and video playback on visited websites, recorded separately from the general browsing History file.
normal_baseline: Entries correspond to legitimate streaming or media sites (video platforms, corporate training portals, etc.) consistent with the user's known media consumption.
anomalies: Media History entries with no corresponding record in the general History table, indicating history was selectively cleared while Media History survived
Playback sessions tied to unfamiliar or suspicious domains not otherwise seen in browsing activity
Watch-time/position data patterns suggesting automated or scripted playback rather than human interaction
anti_forensic_notes: Clearing browsing data through the standard browser history-clearing UI does not clear Media History, so surviving media playback records can corroborate or contradict a claim that all browsing history was wiped.
interpretation: Three primary tables link together: playbackSession (session-level playback events), origin (site-level aggregation), and playback (individual playback records). Join on their session/origin identifiers to reconstruct which site was played, when, and for how long. Because Media History is not cleared by normal history-clearing actions, its presence alongside an empty History file is itself significant.
